podcast.body: This song, a number 21 hit, was written by outspoken frontman Dee Snider and described as a "heartfelt melodic and stirring anthem." Its music video, featuring "Bugs Bunny style comic violence against parents and principals," transformed Twisted Sister into MTV stars, showcasing the band's "garish, flamboyant and deliberately cartoonish" persona and metal's increasing pop visibility. "But it must also be said that their number 21 hit We're Not Gonna Take It, written by outspoken twisted sister frontman D Snyder, was a heartfelt melodic and stirring anthem."
